title: Kraft tardises
description: A datapack that adds the TARDIS and other doctor who items to minecraft vanilla.
body:
This datapack adds content from the TV show Doctor Who to Minecraft, as well as recipes to obtain everything in survival.

# Additions
- a functional TARDIS 
- Working sonic screwdrivers with models (2nd -> 12th)
- Working Dalek Blaster
- working vortex manipulator
- Wearable fezes (in all 16 vanilla dye colours!)
- simple crafting recipes for all new items


# Known Issues
- teleporting the TARDIS to a chunk it is already in breaks the TARDIS exitting. To fix, go to the TARDIS's exact coordinates in the overworld and run ```/trigger tardis_broke_fix``` | I am actively working on fixing this but currently I have nothing.



# Requirements
[Resource Pack for items, models, and sounds](https://modrinth.com/project/nmrsqIkO)
